added: Added to the shelf. Please press start yourself.
adult.context: Choose from daily life, study, or work, and briefly describe how you would use it in other situations.
adult.items: Daily/work supplies, schedule, responsibilities, or prerequisite tasks
adult.scope: 3-5 preparation steps or connecting actual conditions to other situations
attention.choose.action: Choose one target and the action to do now. If other thoughts arise, set them aside only if necessary.
attention.choose.confirm: Verify the target you chose and the action you actually took. Do not intentionally create distractions.
attention.choose.title: Select one target to focus on now
attention.find.action: Decide on one piece of information you need now, then find and mark or state it from the materials.
attention.find.confirm: Confirm why the selected information is necessary for this action.
attention.find.title: Find one piece of information needed
coreRequired: Help is a way of showing information. You perform the selection, connection, and sequence verification yourself.
elementary_1_3.context: Choose or draw from your seat. Explaining in short phrases is also fine.
elementary_1_3.scope: Select two things with drawings and one action to do now
elementary_4_6.context: Pick backpack or desk preparation as an example and state the necessary order and reasons.
elementary_4_6.items: 3-4 items to prepare for school tomorrow or to organize
elementary_4_6.scope: School preparation in 3-4 steps, with one simple reason
generalReason: This is a general exercise, not a recommendation based on testing. Please choose the activities and help that feel comfortable to you.
heading: Small practice for today
high.context: Compare schedules and deadlines to adjust the workload yourself, and leave a reason for your choice.
high.items: Study schedule, assignment deadlines, and actual available time and conditions
high.scope: Compare 2 or more deadlines and conditions, then adjust today's volume and order
initial: Plan at the time of selection
integrated.small.action: Decide the volume of one small task and the first action, or review the plan before executing it yourself.
integrated.small.confirm: Confirm the plan decision, actual execution, and one thing to change next time.
integrated.small.title: Plan and perform one small task
integrated.tomorrow.action: Choose one preparation needed for later, define the scope and method, and do the parts you can do now.
integrated.tomorrow.confirm: Confirm the part you attempted and the point to continue from next time.
integrated.tomorrow.title: One small preparation to do next
invalidBackup: The connection between the recommended activity and the original task/execution is incorrect.
invalidTime: Please enter the estimated time as an integer between 1-1440 minutes or select 'undecided'.
middle.context: Choose preparation for study or a daily event and explain it briefly in your own words.
middle.items: Study materials, a typical daily event, or necessary resources
middle.scope: Volume to prepare or 2-4 steps of a daily event with a short explanation
noEffect: Execution logs and self-reporting are separate. This is not a basis for ability improvement or test accuracy.
optional: Optional - you don't have to answer.
planning.prepare.action: Decide on the amount, order, and time to prepare today among the necessary things yourself.
planning.prepare.confirm: Confirm the amount, order, time, or the reason for any changes.
planning.prepare.title: Create a small preparation plan
planning.tidy.action: Choose one area to organize and decide the extent, order, and how many minutes to spend.
planning.tidy.confirm: Confirm the actual scope decided and any plan adjustments.
planning.tidy.title: Set the amount for organizing one area
responseAfterRun: You can leave feedback on the help after finishing the execution if you wish.
responseCount: Number of times you responded to help
resultReason: Used the official support sequence and current session of the linked result. It does not recalculate scores or types.
reviewOnly: Activity for elementary comparison; not provided for general entry.
safety: Sit down safely to observe or draw. Do not move with eyes closed. If uncomfortable, you may choose to look while connecting. Write only about ordinary events; you do not have to record others' information or difficult memories. It is not evaluated by memory or test scores.
simultaneous.positions.action: Sit safely and draw or write down a few familiar locations without looking, then compare with reality. You may look if you prefer. Explain the relationship between location, object, and use.
simultaneous.positions.confirm: Connect two or more actual items and confirm what is used where and how. No memory scores are assigned.
simultaneous.positions.title: Connect familiar locations and their uses
simultaneous.prepare.action: Connect two or more actual items among materials, locations, and goals, and briefly explain the relationship.
simultaneous.prepare.confirm: Confirm how these preparations are used for the goal in your own words or drawings.
simultaneous.prepare.title: Group the relationship between preparation and goal
successive.event.action: Write or draw a typical event that has already happened in 2-5 steps. Review/modify the sequence and confirm one step yourself.
successive.event.confirm: Verify two or more steps and the sequence/progress marks you confirmed.
successive.event.title: Organize ordinary events in order
successive.prepare.action: Write the actual preparation process in two or more steps, try changing the order, and then proceed with at least one step.
successive.prepare.confirm: Confirm by distinguishing between fixed steps and steps actually performed.
successive.prepare.title: Follow the preparation process in order
title: Task title
unavailable: Please recheck the recommendations for your current age and session.
useCount: Number of times execution was completed
